tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background (Poimandres default, and Poimandres White in light). Dark is the primary theme.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Code blocks, cards, the terminal panel. Sits slightly darker than the page in dark, like an editor's terminal.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and dividers only (decorative, under 3:1). Controls take an ink-muted border.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body text on surface, surface-raised and mint-soft (12:1+ in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, comments in code, outline-button borders; on surface or surface-raised (5.7:1+).

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: Primary accent as text: links, the active item, the fix and the 'after' value. On surface, surface-raised or mint-soft.

tokens.name: mint-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind mint or ink text: the highlighted line in a code block, selected rows.

tokens.name: pink
tokens.usage: Hot accent as text: the problem, the 'before' value, wasted work in diagrams. On either surface.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Structure accent as text: tags, keywords in code, commit hashes, depth labels. On either surface.

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Signal accent as text: the ## heading marks, numbers in code, the nav's > marker. Small doses; on either surface.

tokens.name: mint-fill
tokens.usage: Mint as a FILL: primary button, cover band, correct marbles in diagrams. Text on it is on-fill.

tokens.name: pink-fill
tokens.usage: Pink as a fill: cover band, wasted-work marbles. Text on it is on-fill.

tokens.name: blue-fill
tokens.usage: Blue as a fill: cover band, input marbles. Text on it is on-fill.

tokens.name: cream-fill
tokens.usage: Cream as a fill: the terminal cursor, highlighter marks. Text on it is on-fill.

tokens.name: on-fill
tokens.usage: Text and icons on any *-fill (4.6:1+ on every fill, both themes).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links, an alias of mint.

families.mono: "SauceCodePro NF Web", "SauceCodePro NF", "Source Code Pro", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

groups.name: Mono
groups.note: The voice of the site: headings, labels, code and icons are Sauce Code Pro Nerd Font (Source Code Pro with Nerd Font glyphs), subset to Latin plus the icons the site uses.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Tags, dates, nav items, metadata. Uppercase.

groups.name: Prose
groups.note: Long-form reading stays in a sans for comfort.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The cache miss rate dropped from 18% to 3% once the struct fit in one line.
styles.usage: Article body and paragraphs. Max line length about 70 characters.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Measured on a Ryzen 7, median of 30 runs.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, inline code padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside controls, between tags.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and code block padding; paragraph spacing.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections; one level of indentation in the depth motif.

radius.note: Tight corners. Code-adjacent surfaces (terminal, code blocks, inline code, diagrams, stack chips) are square; everything else is barely rounded.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Code-adjacent surfaces: terminal panels, code blocks, inline code, diagrams, stack chips.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Inline code, tags, focus outlines.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, code blocks, images.
